applications.latestSubject: Complete your application for the EWOR Fellowship
applications.notes: Hi Tirth, After reviewing your initial application, I believe you could be an excellent fit for the EWOR Fellowship. Think of what you have done so far as just the first step. To complete your application, please fill out the form on our website here . A Little Bit About EWOR EWOR is a fellowship for outlier founders building transformative tech. We back the top 0.1% with up to €500K in funding (Traction Mode) or €300K over the course of the fellowship (Ideation Mode) and weekly 1:1 mentorship from unicorn founders (Adjust, ProGlove, SumUp) who have built companies collectively worth over €12B and now work full-time at EWOR. applications.notes: Hi Tirth, Thanks for applying to help us build N26, the bank the world loves to use! We know applying for a job can be exciting, and at times nerve-racking. To provide you some visibility, here's a rundown on our hiring process: Application Review 📜 and Timing ⏳ All of our applications are reviewed by humans - not robots. Due to the volume of applications we receive, reviewing all profiles and providing feedback to each candidate proves to be time-consuming. We aim to get back to applicants within 1 week. Generally we’re pretty good at this, but sometimes it can run a bit longer. We've been there too, so for that reason we’ll do our best to keep the wait to a minimum. Interview Process 🤝 If unfortunately you don’t make it past the CV review, it means that currently you do not meet the requirements for the specific role (for now). If it seems like a good fit, then we’ll reach out to you. In general you can expect a series of digital meetings with different team members paired with a practical challenge. The full interview cycle usually averages between 2 to 4 weeks, but this might vary based on seniority of the role and agenda availability. Successful applicants will be asked to submit professional references and complete a criminal record check. We'll share more details about this when you reach this stage in our hiring process. In the meantime, check out more on what life could be like with us on our LinkedIn ( https://www.linkedin.com/company/n26/ ) page, our N26 Blog ( https://n26.com/en-eu/blog/category/insiden26 ) and our People of N26 Instagram ( https://www.instagram.com/peopleofn26/ ) profile. applications.notes: 🚨 Hiring: AWS WorkSpaces Migration Architect | Remote / Hybrid We are looking for an experienced AWS WorkSpaces Migration Architect for a client-facing role . 📍 Location: Remote / Hybrid 💼 Role: AWS WorkSpaces Migration Architect 🔹 Key Responsibilities Architecture & Migration Leadership Lead discovery, assessment, sizing, dependency mapping, and migration planning. Design migration waves, pilot deployments, cutover strategies, rollback procedures, and transition plans. AWS WorkSpaces Architecture Design and deploy AWS WorkSpaces Personal (Persistent) and AWS WorkSpaces Pools (Non-Persistent) . Design desktop pools based on workload personas and business requirements. Define scaling, capacity planning, high availability, and disaster recovery architectures. Establish profile management and user-experience optimization strategies. applications.latestSubject: Coached: A short story on reinvention (+ more)
applications.notes: If you’ve ever gone weeks or even months without a nibble on your job-hunt… It’s easy to beat yourself up thinking, “No-one wants to hire me!” But here’s the thing: The problem _ISN’T_ that employers hate your resume… It’s that they don’t read it in the first place! You see, employers have a technology that - if not taken into account - will end your chances in the hiring process before it’s even begun. What is this technology? It’s called an Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and it tests your resume on 2 basic things: Test #1: _Can I scan this resume?_ (If it can’t, because your resume uses a weird format, it likely won't get very far.) And Test #2: _How relevant is this resume to the job description?_ If the ATS gives you a poor relevance score, your resume gets kicked to the bottom of the candidate pile, where a hiring manager will click “reject” - without even reading it. (According to Harvard Business School, 88% of candidates are rejected like this) _“But Rohan, even with a low score, a hiring manager can still read my resume, right?”_ Well.. It’s a bit like asking “Could you read a website on page 18 of Google?” Yeah, you can… …but will you? So a better question to ask is… How do you make sure your resume is scannable by the ATS, and ranked high enough so it actually gets read by a human being? Well, for scannability.. If Score My Resume can read it, the ATS can too! And as for being ranked high enough… All you need to do is weave in enough keywords to let the ATS know you’re not a fisherman applying for a forensics job. Of course, the devil’s in the details - you need to know _which_ keywords to include for the position you’re applying for. And that’s where our Targeted Resume tool comes in. Just upload your resume, then paste the job description you’re applying to. In a few seconds, the tool will tell you: 1) How well your resume matches the job description, from 1-100. (which is roughly where the ATS will put you in the candidate pile) and 2) The _exact_ keywords to weave into your resume to increase your score and your chances of getting read by an employer. To find out where the ATS is ranking your resume with the Targeted Resume tool (and if it can be read)… Sign up to Resume Worded Pro here [https://resumeworded.com/buy-pro?useremail=tirthcshah1999@gmail.com] Good luck, Rohan P.S. As beating the ATS is probably _THE_ most important step of resume-writing, I thought it’s only fair to give as many people as possible the chance of using our Targeted Resume Tool. That’s why for the next 5 days, you can grab a 25% discount to Resume Worded Pro. For 25% off, head here. That's awesome. As you’re job searching, you’ve likely thought about applying to a few different roles, which is smart. But you’re probably also wondering, “what should I focus on?” It’s a great question — and it’s where I always tell people to start. Get it right and everything else follows: your resume tells a tighter story, you apply to the right roles, hiring managers see the fit. Develop Lambda/Node.js and Fargate based processing functions to perform extraction, transformation, validation, and related processing for GDMS utility workflows across supported schemas. Implement AWS Step Functions workflows for Claims, Underwriting, and Ad hoc extraction types, orchestrating OpenSearch/DynamoDB queries, processing steps, and downstream actions. We focus on personalized, AI-powered career guidance for job seekers, emphasizing skills over extensive resumes. Our Chief Commercial Officer, Lucas Levine, puts it best https://www.badcredit.org/news/futurefit-ai-reshapes-career-navigation-in-the-digital-age/: “It doesn’t matter who the individual is, where they came from, what they look like, or which college they attended. And that’s what we’re ultimately trying to deliver — connecting job seekers with the resources they need to put their best foot forward, and making sure employers don’t overlook the talent they bring to the table.” Challenges as ambitious as this require a daring and passionate team, and you might be a great fit. Due to the volume of candidates, we aren’t always able to get in touch. We strive to do this in a timely manner, and if qualified, our goal is to reach out in 1-3 weeks. As we open roles, we also go through past candidates, so it may be sooner or later than that time frame! * A comprehensive interview process. After getting in touch with our Talent Acquisition team, the interview process will consist of phone calls, case studies or challenges, and video interviews. We work hard to make the process as efficient as possible, but sometimes it is a little longer so we make sure you meet key members. We want to make sure you have the chance to evaluate us as you are analyzing your options. We are excited to learn more about you! applications.notes: Hi Tirth, Thank you for your interest in Redwood Materials! Your email has been received and we're excited that you would consider joining our team. Redwood’s goal is to develop and deploy new technologies for dramatically increasing the scope and scale of recycled and sustainable materials in global supply chains. We’re passionate about building a sustainable future and changing the world with a small team. With that said, we’re thrilled that you’re excited about helping us solve this super important and difficult environmental problem. We will review your information as soon as we can and we'll be in touch if your qualifications align with our needs. Due to the volume of emails received, we want to be respectful of your time and let you know that we will only be reaching out to candidates whose skillsets best match our roles. If our team feels that you’re a fit, we will contact you shortly about next steps. If you don’t hear back immediately, don't worry! We're growing fast and will have new roles opening up in the future, so please keep an eye on our website for updates! Recycle with Us Redwood’s focus is to take both end-of-life electric vehicle batteries and other lithium-ion powered consumer devices and then recycle, refine, and remanufacture them into new products here in America. The largest lithium and cobalt mines in the western hemisphere can be found in the junk drawers of America and we’re on a mission to collect as many of these old products as possible. We encourage all candidates, visitors, and guests to bring old phones, laptops, tablets, electric toothbrushes, and any other rechargeable device with a lithium-ion battery. For more information about our consumer recycling program, please visit our website ( https://www.redwoodmaterials.com/recyclewithus ). Thanks, Redwood Recruiting

applications.latestSubject: Are you looking for full time Opportunity
applications.notes: Hi, Tirth Chirayu Shah I hope you're doing well. I came across your profile and was genuinely impressed by your background. Based on your experience, I believe you could be a strong fit for several full-time opportunities we're currently supporting with direct clients across the U.S. Our team works closely with IT professionals by helping them improve their job search strategy, increase interview opportunities, and connect with employers that match their skills and long-term career goals.
